name: How long does a main water line repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a main water line repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a main water line repair depends on the extent of the damage, the type of repair needed, and the location of the pipe. Minor repairs, like patching a small leak, might take a few hours. More extensive damage requiring full pipe replacement, especially if trenching is involved, could take one to three days. Factors like soil conditions and access to the line can also influence the timeline. We prioritize efficient service to minimize disruption to your water supply.
acceptedAnswer.description: Main water line repairs can take a few hours for minor issues or up to three days for full replacements, depending on the damage and complexity.
